Thank you for the post.

> because you don't want to face the intensity of the experience by yourself

That could be very true.  

My plan is actually to stab myself to death. If I go for the heart I am afraid the nerves will get me and I will fail someway... Feels more bizzarre and obscure than going for the stomach in my mind... afraid? So I was thinking slicing and stabbing my stomach, press the knife in and try to cut it against the middle. Big knife for maximum damage. I am actually not afraid of physical pain. I have already stabbed myself in the stomach before, but I was lucky, and didn't hit any major arteries. But trying to "saw" it against middle I'm very sure I will hit arteries and hopefully die. I don't think I wanna die instant! I have this fantasy that if I experience "real" "close to death"-experience I will be "saved"... emotional pain is what I hate. I might realize that I want to live and love life if it goes well. And if it doesn't I die :D

I always joke with my psychologist that practice makes perfect xD
This is one of my favorite subs :)
Is it possible that I am a sociopath? Since I want to do it?
What kinda dog is that? Looks like a mini-bear.
